method: Exploratory fixed-budget six direct geometric-loss candidates plus fresh pure-FM baseline
user_override: All seven arms start at the same pure G0 cumulative2500 and add500 updates; final cumulative3000. Prior2500 G0 is not the new L0.

training.target_noise: Original free-only nested Hungarian OT permutes only Z; actual target/source face and corner identities follow target slots
training.FM_denominator: Original total effective-batch valid free coordinates
training.geometry_denominator: Each sample defined mean; sum over all eight samples divided by8, with inactive samples contributing0
training.coordinate_scale: Only loss coordinates divide by fixed full-GT bbox diagonal; model/input coordinates unchanged
training.precision: Original BF16 generator; FP32 parameters/integration/geometric computation with geometric autocast disabled

L1.name: GT adjacent local side consistency
L1.relations: Trusted GT source shared edges between known and free; fixed across predictions
L1.sign: sign((GT free off-edge vertex - known edge reference) dot known unit normal)
L1.points: Three vertices, three edge midpoints, centroid
L1.inapplicable: Coplanar/ambiguous signed relationships counted, not assigned arbitrary side
L1.limitations: Not global SDF, IPC, or nonadjacent triangle collision prevention

L2.name: GT adjacent unoriented dihedral preservation
L2.relations: Every actual GT shared-edge incident-face pair with >=1 free face; known-known excluded
L2.normal_epsilon_units: cross product after division of coordinates by L
L2.weights: Only fixed GT edge length, never predicted proximity
L2.limitations: Translation, topology separation, sign and concavity ambiguities remain

L3.name: Along-interface-edge tangential relaxation
L3.parallel: tau*tau^T*r; tau is fixed GT shared-edge unit tangent
L3.relations: Trusted known-free source edge endpoints, with normal multiple-edge incidence weighting
L3.limitations: No projection, welding, or exact-edge guarantee

L4.name: Area-weighted surface Sinkhorn divergence
L4.probability: clamp_min(A_normalized,1e-12)/3, then normalize each measure to unit mass; predicted area retains gradient
L4.solver: 96 fixed simultaneous half-damped Jacobi log-domain updates from zero dual potentials; full unrolled differentiation
L4.GTGT_cache: Only detached GT-GT constant may be reused; actual solve/cache counts separate
L4.marginal_residuals: Each solve row/column L1, Linf and max relative residual
L4.limitations: Finite-iteration approximate balanced OT; independent probability normalization does not constrain total area

L5.name: Multiscale area and unsigned-normal surface measure
L5.quadrature: Same three symmetric barycentric points as L4
L5.weights: w_pred=A_pred/(3*A_GT_total), w_GT=A_GT/(3*A_GT_total), with detached GT total area; prediction is not mass-renormalized
L5.Q: n*n^T; normalized cross product with epsilon1e-8
L5.GTGT_cache: Detached GT-GT kernels only; actual kernel counts separate
L5.limitations: Finite quadrature, unsigned normal and surface-measure approximation, not exact topology or self-intersection guarantee

L6.name: Known-free boundary and unknown-side band coverage
L6.relations: Only actual trusted GT known-free shared edges, not all open C edges
L6.surface: Differentiable finite predicted free triangles only; fixed C excluded
L6.nearest_triangle: Piecewise differentiable choice; selected distance is not detached
L6.limitations: Finite local samples, barycentric rather than fixed physical band; may sacrifice remote coverage

calibration.saved_velocities: One generator velocity per registered state; then independent velocity leaves, no extra generator calls per loss
calibration.invalid: No finite nonzero denominator stops candidate; never invent fallback lambda
calibration.interpretation: Initial output-space scale only, not whole-model or sustained10% gradient guarantee

failure_policy.numerical_nonfinite: Stop affected candidate and preserve exception/counts; continue unrelated candidates
failure_policy.finite_L4_residual: Report finite96-step approximation;1e-3 diagnostic does not automatically stop or trigger retries
failure_policy.existing_BF16_permutation_failure: Preserve historical FAIL and tolerance; authorized baseline-inheritance contract; no new historical diagnosis

evaluation.architecture: Original strict T1+Geo generator only, no losses/GT/heads/guidance/repair during sampling

confirmation.models: L0 plus at most two frozen selected candidates

evaluation.per_patch_reference: Each patch own free GT complement, original fixed evaluation points and thresholds
evaluation.original_patches: Previously observed parents and patches; confirmation introduces only new noise
evaluation.historical_G0: Reference-only24 old outputs may be reused, never counted as fresh L0 or ranked

selection.method: exploratory fixed-budget direct geometry loss screen
selection.initialization: User override: common G0 cumulative2500; seven fresh500-update arms end cumulative3000
selection.baseline: Fresh L0 cumulative3000; prior G0 cumulative2500 is historical context only, excluded from ranking
selection.aggregation: Within each parent/patch average registered noises, then equal mean of six cells
selection.selection: Independent global best non-L0 RMS and Gamma slots; require strict improvement over L0; deduplicate, never fill with runner-up
selection.paired_sign: candidate minus reference; no marginal-median subtraction
selection.confirmation: New noise on previously seen parents/patches, not new-object or independent-training-seed replication
selection.quality: Report tradeoffs; no post-hoc composite score or additional quality selection threshold
selection.eligibility: Exclude numerical failure, changed C or wrong face count
selection.macro: Noise mean within each parent/patch, then equal weight for six parent/patch cells
selection.select: Take independently best nonbaseline RMS and independently best nonbaseline Gamma; each must strictly beat L0; deduplicate same winner; no runner-up replacement

budgets.distribution_internal_solves: Actual per-call accounting, separate from original noise OT; GT-GT cache reuse distinguished

limitations: Exploratory selection over six candidates, not independent discovery
Two trained parents and already-observed patches
No loss guarantees watertightness, shared topology or absence of intersections
stop: No seventh candidate, combinations, changed lambda/time/steps, automatic extension, commit or push
